26	/**
27	 * Returns the requesting IP for rate-limit keying.
28	 * Falls back to 'unknown' when the header is absent (local dev).
29	 */
30	async function getClientIp(): Promise<string> {
31	  const hdrs = await headers()
32	  return hdrs.get('x-forwarded-for') ?? hdrs.get('x-real-ip') ?? 'unknown'
33	}

35	/**
36	 * Derives a studio display name from the user's full name.
37	 * e.g. "Alex Rivera" → "Alex Rivera Tattoo"
38	 * Only used when the studio name is the signup default "My Studio".
39	 */
40	function autoStudioName(fullName: string): string {
41	  const trimmed = fullName.trim()
42	  if (!trimmed) return 'My Studio'
43	  return `${trimmed} Tattoo`
44	}
45	
46	/**
47	 * Returns a unique slug by appending 4 random hex chars if the given slug
48	 * is already taken by another studio.
49	 */
50	async function resolveUniqueStudioSlug(
51	  supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>,
52	  currentStudioId: string,
53	  slug: string,
54	): Promise<string> {
55	  const { data: conflict } = await supabase
56	    .from('studios')
57	    .select('id')
58	    .eq('slug', slug)
59	    .neq('id', currentStudioId)
60	    .maybeSingle()
61	
62	  if (!conflict) return slug
63	
64	  const suffix = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xffff)
65	    .toString(16)
66	    .padStart(4, '0')
67	  return `${slug}-${suffix}`
68	}

70	// ─── completeOnboardingWithPersona ────────────────────────────────────────────
71	
72	export async function completeOnboardingWithPersona(
73	  studioId: string,
74	  input: unknown,
75	): Promise<ActionResult<{ redirectTo: string }>> {
76	  const ip = await getClientIp()
77	  const { success: allowed } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
78	  if (!allowed) {
79	    return { ok: false, error: 'Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.' }
80	  }
81	
82	  const supabase = await createClient()
83	  const {
84	    data: { user },
85	    error: authError,
86	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
87	
88	  if (authError || !user) {
89	    return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' }
90	  }
91	
92	  // Validate member is the owner
93	  const { data: member, error: memberError } = await supabase
94	    .from('studio_members')
95	    .select('role')
96	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
97	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
98	    .single()
99	
100	  if (memberError || !member) {
101	    return { ok: false, error: 'Studio not found.' }
102	  }
103	
104	  if (member.role !== 'owner') {
105	    return { ok: false, error: 'Only the studio owner can complete onboarding.' }
106	  }
107	
108	  const parsed = personaPickerSchema.safeParse(input)
109	  if (!parsed.success) {
110	    return { ok: false, error: parsed.error.errors[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' }
111	  }
112	  const data = parsed.data
113	
114	  // Fetch current studio
115	  const { data: currentStudio, error: studioFetchError } = await supabase
116	    .from('studios')
117	    .select('id, name, slug')
118	    .eq('id', studioId)
119	    .single()
120	
121	  if (studioFetchError || !currentStudio) {
122	    logger.error({ studioId, err: studioFetchError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: studio fetch failed')
123	    return { ok: false, error: "We couldn't save your profile. Try again, or refresh the page." }
124	  }
125	
126	  // Auto-derive studio name if still default
127	  const isDefaultName = currentStudio.name === 'My Studio' || !currentStudio.name
128	  const newStudioName = isDefaultName ? autoStudioName(data.fullName) : currentStudio.name
129	
130	  // Compute slug from new name if we're changing it
131	  let finalSlug = currentStudio.slug
132	  if (isDefaultName) {
133	    const rawSlug = slugify(newStudioName)
134	    if (rawSlug && rawSlug !== currentStudio.slug) {
135	      finalSlug = await resolveUniqueStudioSlug(supabase, studioId, rawSlug)
136	    }
137	  }
138	
139	  // Update studio name + slug + timezone + mark onboarded
140	  const { error: studioUpdateError } = await supabase
141	    .from('studios')
142	    .update({
143	      name: newStudioName,
144	      slug: finalSlug,
145	      timezone: data.timezone,
146	      onboarded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
147	    })
148	    .eq('id', studioId)
149	
150	  if (studioUpdateError) {
151	    logger.error({ studioId, err: studioUpdateError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: studio update failed')
152	    return { ok: false, error: "We couldn't save your profile. Try again, or refresh the page." }
153	  }
154	
155	  // Update profile: full_name + onboarding_persona + onboarded_at
156	  const { error: profileUpdateError } = await supabase
157	    .from('profiles')
158	    .update({
159	      full_name: data.fullName,
160	      onboarding_persona: data.persona,
161	      onboarded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
162	    })
163	    .eq('id', user.id)
164	
165	  if (profileUpdateError) {
166	    logger.error({ userId: user.id, err: profileUpdateError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: profile update failed')
167	    // Non-fatal — continue
168	  }
169	
170	  // Upsert artist row (solo_artist persona: user IS the artist)
171	  const { data: existingArtist } = await supabase
172	    .from('artists')
173	    .select('id')
174	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
175	    .eq('profile_id', user.id)
176	    .maybeSingle()
177	
178	  if (existingArtist) {
179	    const { error: artistUpdateError } = await supabase
180	      .from('artists')
181	      .update({ display_name: data.fullName, specialties: [] })
182	      .eq('id', existingArtist.id)
183	
184	    if (artistUpdateError) {
185	      logger.error({ studioId, userId: user.id, err: artistUpdateError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: artist update failed')
186	    }
187	  } else {
188	    const { error: artistInsertError } = await supabase
189	      .from('artists')
190	      .insert({
191	        studio_id: studioId,
192	        profile_id: user.id,
193	        display_name: data.fullName,
194	        specialties: [],
195	      })
196	
197	    if (artistInsertError) {
198	      logger.error({ studioId, userId: user.id, err: artistInsertError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: artist insert failed')
199	    }
200	  }
201	
202	  await logAuditAction(
203	    user.id,
204	    'onboarding.persona_completed',
205	    { type: 'profile', id: user.id },
206	    { persona: data.persona },
207	    studioId,
208	  )
209	
210	  return { ok: true, data: { redirectTo: '/dashboard' } }
211	}

215	export async function getOnboardingStatus(): Promise<OnboardingStatus> {
216	  const supabase = await createClient()
217	
218	  const {
219	    data: { user },
220	    error: authError,
221	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
222	
223	  if (authError || !user) {
224	    return { studioId: null, isOnboarded: false, persona: null, fullName: null }
225	  }
226	
227	  // Fetch studio membership
228	  const { data: memberRow } = await supabase
229	    .from('studio_members')
230	    .select('studio_id, studios(onboarded_at)')
231	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
232	    .is('deactivated_at', null)
233	    .order('joined_at', { ascending: true })
234	    .limit(1)
235	    .single()
236	
237	  if (!memberRow) {
238	    return { studioId: null, isOnboarded: false, persona: null, fullName: null }
239	  }
240	
241	  const studioData = Array.isArray(memberRow.studios)
242	    ? memberRow.studios[0]
243	    : memberRow.studios
244	
245	  const isOnboarded = !!(studioData?.onboarded_at)
246	
247	  const { data: profile } = await supabase
248	    .from('profiles')
249	    .select('full_name, onboarding_persona')
250	    .eq('id', user.id)
251	    .single()
252	
253	  const persona = (profile?.onboarding_persona ?? null) as Persona | null
254	  const fullName = profile?.full_name ?? null
255	
256	  return {
257	    studioId: memberRow.studio_id,
258	    isOnboarded,
259	    persona,
260	    fullName,
261	  }
262	}
